intent_instructions:
Classify the user's goal into one intake label. Reply with ONLY valid JSON matching the schema below.
intake_label: - "quiz": greeting/thanks/static trivia/definitions/simple math answerable from training knowledge WITHOUT tools/files/web/live-data. - "trivial": a single obvious tool call or direct answer; no decomposition needed. Examples: "what time is it?", "list files in this directory", "what is 2+2". - "simple": a single focused step with light planning. Examples: "read RFC-220 and summarize the topology", "show me the first 50 lines of config.yml". - "complex": multi-step, architectural, migration, or multi-phase work. Examples: "refactor the persistence layer", "add a new agent subcommand with tests".
NOT quiz (use trivial/simple/complex): - Real-time or time-sensitive: weather/news/stocks/sports/rates/traffic/flights. - Needs web search, external APIs, attached files, code execution, or tools. - Questions you cannot answer confidently from training knowledge alone. - Follow-ups on prior conversation or work. - runtime state queries: workspace, cwd, configured model, available tools, current loop/goal/thread, policies, environment.
When uncertain between two labels, prefer the MORE capable one (e.g. trivial-vs-simple → simple; simple-vs-complex → complex).
When intake_label is "quiz", also provide: - quiz_response: concise direct answer from training knowledge. For greetings/thanks: brief polite reply. For "who are you": self-identify as {assistant_name}, not vendor/model names.
When intake_label is not "quiz", also provide: - reasoning: ONE brief first-person sentence (max 20 words) starting with "I'll" or "Let me" — what you will do next and why tools/action are needed. Examples: "I'll inspect the repo layout to map the architecture.", "Let me search the web for today's weather.", "I'll continue from our prior thread and summarize the draft." - goal_description: normalized goal description.
JSON schema: {{"intake_label":"quiz"|"trivial"|"simple"|"complex","reasoning":"string|null","goal_description":"string|null","quiz_response":"string|null"}}
